frontmatter.sidebar_description: Manage the links between a collection and products.

blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `batchLinkProductsToCategoryWorkflow`. It belongs to the `@arcangel/arcangel/core-flows` package.

This workflow manages the links between a category and products. It's used by the
[Manage Products of Category Admin API Route](https://docs.arcangel.com/api/admin/product-categories/manage-products).

You can use this workflow within your own customizations or custom workflows to manage the products in a category.
